order.purpose: Remove remaining explicit MCP singleton registrations from the filtered common entrypoint; use Minv-specific main IPC/lock identity; disable the unimplemented updater; restrict upstream dependency installation directories.
order.appliesAfter: Exact entrypoint import filtering in scripts/prepare-upstream.mjs

generatedTransforms: Replace product.json with the independent Minv identity; exclude remote assets, accounts, marketplace, default agents and updater endpoints.
Filter desktop/common side-effect imports against the exact source-hashed allowlist in product/contributions.json.
Delete extension directories outside product/extensions.json. Retained extensions contain only declarative contribution keys and no executable entrypoint.
Remove Copilot and agent-host package scripts and keep compile/watch focused on the desktop client. Dependency removal and build graph validation are still release blockers.
